question:
**Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the following word.**

Solicit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Request**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Solicit **means to ask for or seek something, often in a formal or earnest manner. (कुछ माँगना, अक्सर औपचारिक या गंभीर तरीके से)
 
• It can also mean trying to obtain something from someone.
 
 
• **For example**: *The charity organization is soliciting donations for the flood victims.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Request **means to ask for something politely or formally. (विनम्रतापूर्वक या औपचारिक रूप से कुछ माँगना)
 
 
• **For example**:* I would like to kindly request an extension for the deadline on my project to ensure I can deliver my best work.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pretend**: to behave in a way that is not genuine or true. (इस तरह से व्यवहार करना जो वास्तविक या सच्चा नहीं है)
 
• **Degrade**: to lower in dignity or honour; to reduce in rank or status. (गरिमा या सम्मान में कमी करना; पद या पद में कमी करना)
 
• **Complicate**: to make something more difficult or confusing. (किसी चीज़ को अधिक कठिन या भ्रमित करने वाला बनाना)
